_comment: Baselined locale-only misses. An assertion literal that resolves in app/components source but in NO i18n locale file is hard-coded JSX: it renders now and breaks when that screen is wired to a locale key or run under a non-en locale. flow-xcheck BLOCKS any such literal not listed here. These 39 predate the gate and are grandfathered so it did not have to reject working flows; one further literal, unmasked by the 2026-10-04 dead-screen purge, was added the same day; each entry must be deleted as its screen is localized. This file must only ever SHRINK.
